name: Prime Lase
description: Multi-wavelength laser platform (755/810/810+940+1060/1060 nm) with up to 4800W power for hair removal across all skin types, plus skin rejuvenation, vascular and pigmented lesion treatment, and acne therapy. Uses Ultra Short Pulse and Crystal Freeze (5°C handpiece) technology; whole-body treatment in ~30 minutes.
features: Four wavelengths: 755nm Alex, 810nm Diode, 810+940+1060nm Blend, 1060nm Nd:Yag
Ultra Short Pulse technology, 3ms minimum pulse width
Top Hat spot technology for uniform energy transfer

name: Elysion Pro
description: Hair removal laser with four handpieces (755nm Alex, 810nm Diode, 810+940+1060nm Blend, 1060nm Nd:Yag) delivering over 3000W. Crystal Freeze cooling for comfortable, no-downtime treatments across all skin types (I-VI), roughly 4x faster than comparable devices.
features: Crystal Freeze technology, no recovery time
No maintenance fee, no consumption costs

name: Angela MX_7000
description: Fractional CO2 laser using SmartPulse technology (a high-power ablative phase followed by a thermal phase) to create up to 4,489 columns per 20x20mm section, stimulating collagen and new vessel formation with reduced thermal damage and PIH risk. Covers skin rejuvenation and gynecological/urological applications.
features: Ultra Pulse Mode for pain reduction
Three laser radiation patterns: array, grid, random
Low Pain Fractional Mode for sensitive patients

name: Ashley
description: Micro-needle radiofrequency device that penetrates the dermis with fine, gold-insulated needles delivering high-frequency energy, minimizing epidermal destruction versus conventional fractional lasers. Adjustable penetration depth (0.5mm-4mm) enables fast treatment with minimal recovery time.
features: No wounds, burns, or pigmentation side effects
applications: Sagging skin and open pore treatment

name: Cooltech / Cooltech Define
description: Cryolipolysis platform that freezes subcutaneous fat tissue to -8°C, triggering apoptosis to permanently eliminate fat cells without harming surrounding tissue. Cooltech Define adds 9 ergonomic handpieces, 4 simultaneous applicators, 360-degree cooling, and an optical detection system; full-body contouring in about 2 hours.
features: 9 ergonomic handpieces adaptable to all body areas (Define)
RFID cool gel pad system, optical detection sensors
applications: Abdomen, arms, armpits, chin/submental, inner thigh, knee, pubic region, back and flank fat reduction

name: Powershape 2
description: 3-in-1 cellulite and local fat treatment system combining radiofrequency, vacuum, and low-level laser. RF delivers thermal energy via bipolar/multipolar handpieces, vacuum improves circulation and lymphatic drainage, and targeted laser wavelengths reduce fat cell size. Usable on all body types, all skin types, and the face.
features: Vacuum suction for circulation and lymphatic drainage
Painless, no anesthesia, no cuts or downtime

name: 4Plus
description: Multipurpose radiofrequency platform using Dynamic Quadrupole RF (DQRF) to precisely target epidermis, dermis, and hypodermis for face and body rejuvenation, tightening, and contouring. Six technologies in one platform, fully non-invasive, no anesthesia or cooling system required, with five handpieces including a 384-microneedle fractional RF tip.
features: Six technologies in one platform (IOMT, DQRF, UPR, RSS, VRF)
Five handpieces incl. fractional RF with 384 gold-plated microneedles
No anesthesia or cooling system required

name: Tesla Former
description: Functional Magnetic Stimulation (FMS) device that generates a pulsed magnetic field to trigger supermaximal muscle contractions, building muscle faster than conventional strength training, without skin contact or electrode discomfort. Delivers up to 50,000 pulses per 30-minute session, no operator or recovery period required.
features: Targets abdomen, hips, hamstrings, arms, pelvic floor, legs, mid-body

name: InBody
description: Body composition analyzer using direct electrical impedance measurement, giving results independent of estimation-based parameters like gender and age, so clinics can analyze body composition in-office without relying on population averages.

name: Pico Premium
description: Picosecond laser system (Nd:YAG 532/1064nm, plus 595/660nm capability) with a 350-picosecond pulse width — among the shortest available — enabling effective treatment of tattoos and pigmented lesions that don't respond to conventional nanosecond lasers, with minimal pain and quick sessions.
features: High peak power across all tattoo colors/depths

name: Q10
description: Q-switched Nd:YAG laser (1064nm, convertible to 532nm) targeting melanin and hemoglobin to treat vascular lesions, pigmented lesions, melasma, and tattoo ink. Flat Top-Hat beam profile ensures stable, uniform energy transmission; Genesis Mode enables Nano Peeling.
features: Genesis Mode Nano Peeling (330-400 / 1000 microsecond pulses)

name: Exciplex
description: Compact excimer phototherapy device (308nm XeCl, monochrome UVB) with optical power three times higher than other manual excimers, a 25cm² spot size, and sub-1kg weight for fast, comfortable, near side-effect-free treatment of vitiligo, psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, alopecia areata, and mycosis fungoides.
features: Optical power 3x higher than manual excimers, up to 3x faster treatment

name: Wolf
description: Compact, portable 1470nm diode laser system (also available at 445nm/10W and 980nm/18W) for treating vascular lesions of the lower limbs, with simple operation, low maintenance, an integrated cooling system, and support for multiple user profiles.
